title: linuxlive distro spec
description: Describes one custom distro: its base, desktop, apps and branding.

name.description: Display name, shown in the boot menu, the About screen and os-release.

id.description: Machine-friendly name used for the hostname, file names and os-release IMAGE_ID. Derived from name when omitted.

version.description: Version of this distro, for example 0.1 or 2026.10.

apps.description: Catalog app IDs to preinstall from Flathub.

flathub.description: Any other apps from Flathub, by their Flathub ID, for example org.gnome.Chess. The build checks each with Flathub's API.

wallpaper.description: PNG or JPEG, at least 1280x720, relative to the spec file.

logo.description: Square PNG of 128, 256 or 512 pixels, relative to the spec file.

splash.description: Optional boot splash of the distro's own: a Plymouth script and the PNG images it draws, relative to the spec file. Without it, the boot splash is the logo over a spinner.

script.description: A Plymouth script (the script plugin's language: images and sprites only, no commands).

images.description: PNG images the script loads by file name. The logo is there too, as watermark.png.

settings.description: How the system is set up: language, keyboard, time zone, computer name, login and the menu.

language.description: The system's language and formats, as a locale from the catalog, for example de_DE.

keyboard.description: Keyboard layout, as an XKB layout from the catalog, for example de.

timezone.description: Time zone, as a name from the tz database, for example Europe/Berlin.

hostname.description: The computer's name on the network. Defaults to the id.

autologin.description: Installed systems log their user in without a password (the installer's option starts ticked). The live session always does.

hidden_apps.description: Menu entries to hide, by desktop file name without .desktop, for example org.gnome.Tour.

dock.description: Apps pinned to the dock or panel, in order, after the file manager: ids from apps or flathub (since v0.9.0).

firefox.description: Firefox's home page and bookmarks, set as policies for everyone. Needs firefox in apps.

homepage.description: The page Firefox starts with and its Home button opens.

bookmarks.description: Bookmarks on the bookmarks toolbar, in order.

arches.description: Which CPUs to build ISOs for: amd64 (PCs, the default) and arm64 (for example virtual machines on Apple-silicon Macs). Each gets its own ISO.

persistence.description: Save files and settings back to the USB stick the live system runs from. Ubuntu-based distros only, for now.

kiosk.description: Kiosk mode: the computer starts straight into one app, full screen, with no desktop around it.

app.description: The app: one of apps, or a Flathub ID from flathub.

packages.description: Packages from the base's own archive (Ubuntu's apt or Fedora's dnf), installed into the image.

files.description: Files copied into the image, under /etc or /usr. At most 20 MB in all.

src.description: The file, relative to the spec file and inside its folder.

dest.description: Where it goes in the system: an absolute path under /etc or /usr.

mode.description: Permissions in octal, for example "0644" (the default) or "0755".

scripts.description: Shell scripts of the distro's own, relative to the spec file and inside its folder, run in order.

build.description: Run as root while the image is built, with the network, after packages, apps and files.

first-boot.description: Run once as root on an installed system, before its first login screen.

first-login.description: Run once for each user at their first login, as that user. In the live session, at every start.

repos.description: Code from GitHub, fetched at an exact commit and built into the image with its run command.

run.description: Shell commands run as root in the repository's checkout, for example: make install PREFIX=/usr
